samples.xml_description:
<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>A sequence detector to detect the specific sequence 1001.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used to synchronize the detector.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">The active low reset signal to initialize the state machine.</input>
        <input id="data_in">A 1-bit binary input signal representing the next bit in the bitstream being processed.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">A 1-bit output signal indicating whether the specific sequence has been successfully detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Waiting for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">First bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">Second bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">Third bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">Fourth bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[3:0]">Register to store the current state of the sequence detector.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[3:0]">Register to store the next state of the sequence detector.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n)>
            if (reset_n == 1'b1) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential Logic Block
        always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n) begin
            if (reset_n == 1'b1) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational Logic Block
        always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                S1: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S2: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S3: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end
        
        // Output Logic
        assign sequence_detected = (current_state == S4);
    </implementation>
</module>
